title: create-enum-helper
summary: Generates a Byte-family record helper (ToByte/FromByte/ToInteger/ FromInteger/ToString/FromString) for an enum type
intro: Read this when you have an enum and want the usual conversion helpers without writing them by hand. create-enum-helper generates a Byte-family record helper with ToByte, FromByte, ToInteger, FromInteger, ToString and FromString; without --apply it is a dry run (exit 0, nothing written; --json reports action and applied=false). Exit 0 when a helper is built, 1 when refused (for example action=exists), 2 on usage or a missing --db. Note --json together with --apply still writes.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH] - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
help: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH]  - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
--methods tobyte,frombyte,tointeger,frominteger,tostring,fromstring (default: all 6); --tostring rtti (default, RTTI GetEnumName) or case (explicit case statement)
idempotent: a helper for the enum already indexed anywhere -> action=exists, no edit

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Enum Record Helper (symbol)...
steps: Put the caret on the enum type in the editor (the name box is prefilled from the caret)
Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Enum Record Helper (symbol)...
Confirm the qualified name, then choose Yes to write the helper or No for a dry-run preview; the Structure form right-click Create helper class always writes

questions.ask: How do I generate ToByte/FromByte/ToString helpers for an enum?
How do I preview the helper first?

notes: issued by the plugin from TDragLintStructureForm.CreateEnumHelperClick (DragLint.Plugin.StructureForm.pas) and InvokeCreateEnumHelper (DragLint.Plugin.Editor.pas)
